main.description: Keeps, on the appview, a device to send the asking account's notifications to, from then on. A device already registered to another account moves to this one.

errors.description: The token is not hexadecimal, the environment is not one this appview knows, or the key is not 32 bytes in base64.
errors.name: InvalidRequest

environment.description: Which of Apple's push services issued the token.

key.description: A 32-byte AES-256-GCM key the device made, in base64. A private repository's notifications are sealed with it, for the app to open on the device; to a device without one, they name nothing.

token.description: The device's push token from Apple, in hexadecimal.

description: Asks this appview to send the asking account's notifications to a device.
